function: Excluded (function): the learned BS and RIS codebooks and codeword selection serve uplink localization of the user, a positioning task outside the seven areas (p. 5).
notes: Exclude, reason function. p. 5: "the goal of the localization problem is to estimate the unknown user position"; the loss is the position MSE (p. 8) and the only metric is the localization RMSE (p. 10). No rate, SNR or other communication objective is optimized, so this is positioning and sensing alone, not area 3 or area 5.
